sourceCopy.name: Car Lease Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Car Lease Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate a car lease payment from price, residual value, term, money factor, cap reduction, and tax. Free, private estimate.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate monthly lease payments from the capitalized cost, residual value, lease length, money factor, any cap-cost reduction, and a tax rate you enter.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How is a car lease payment estimated?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: The estimate separates monthly depreciation from the rent charge: depreciation is adjusted capitalized cost minus residual value, divided by the term; the rent charge is their sum multiplied by the money factor. An optional entered tax rate is applied to the pre-tax payment.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The estimate runs in this browser tab. Inputs are not uploaded or automatically saved.

fields.currencyNote: Use one currency for every money amount. Enter the money factor as a decimal, such as 0.002.
fields.accuracyNote: Illustrative arithmetic only. A lease quote can include fees, taxes on different bases, incentives, mileage limits, due-at-signing amounts and local rules not modeled here. Verify every number with the lessor.
fields.privacyNote: Your entries stay in this browser tab. They are not uploaded or automatically saved.
fields.formulaNote: Adjusted cost = capitalized cost − reduction. Monthly depreciation = (adjusted cost − residual) ÷ months. Monthly rent charge = (adjusted cost + residual) × money factor. Tax is applied only to the estimated pre-tax monthly payment.
fields.estimatedPaymentsPlusCapReduction: Payments over term plus cap reduction

actions.privacyNote: Names and pairings stay on this device.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the money factor?
additionalFaqs.answer: It is a lease pricing input used by this estimate in the rent-charge formula. Enter the factor from a quote; this tool does not convert an APR or verify a lender’s method.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the monthly estimate include every lease charge?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The optional tax is applied to this estimate’s pre-tax payment only. Registration, acquisition and disposition fees, insurance, mileage charges, local tax treatment, incentives and amounts due at signing may change an actual quote.

additionalFaqs.question: Is this a loan payment calculator?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. A lease estimate includes a residual value and a rent charge. It does not calculate ownership, a loan amortization schedule, vehicle value, or whether a lease is affordable.
